svg.title: Bloom: Four-colour Ben-Day newsprint
svg.desc: Bloom (1D): a city district as a grid of blocks printed on yellowed newsprint in four-colour Ben-Day dots under a heavy black keyline. The spread is printed in rust and ochre dots, thick near the source rooftop and thinning downwind; cordoned cells are struck through with black bars, and crews stand at the cordons as small keyed figures. A wind arrow and a tick counter sit in the margin, and the east edge of the grid, where the settlement is, is outlined in red.
